body: Create an animation-ready modular 2D cel shaded fantasy game cutout atlas, Arcane Vanguard style, bold clean dark outlines, painterly cel shading, detailed but readable at small size. Landscape high-resolution image on TRUE transparent alpha. SIX separate equally sized panels arranged THREE columns TWO rows. View directions reading order: E right profile, SE front-right threequarter, SW front-left threequarter, W left profile, NW rear-left threequarter, NE rear-right threequarter. Rear views show BACK of skull/hair, BACK of clothing, no face or front chest ornament. Every panel contains exactly12 ISOLATED BODY PIECES in3columns4rows, consistent local ordering: row1 head, upper torso from neck to waist ONLY, rear cape; row2 pelvis/skirt, anatomical left upperarm, right upperarm; row3 left forearm including hand, right forearm including hand, left leg without foot; row4 right leg without foot, left boot, right boot. No full figures. Head entirely detached from torso. Arms split at elbows. Legs stop at ankles. NO equipment or effects in body sheet. Large transparent gutters between every cutout and everypanel. Avoid labels, checkerboard, background, panels, borders. Do not connect pieces. Full consistent identity across six genuine rotations. Subject: Female elderly skeletal witch, curved black witch hood/cowl with bone antler ornaments, ivory skull face, ragged plum and charcoal robes with pale green ribbons, slender bony hands. Distinct angular witch silhouette.
equipment: Create 2D cel shaded fantasy game weapon cutout atlas on true transparent alpha, matching dark outlined painterly Arcane Vanguard necromancer reference style. EXACT SIX isolated views of same prop,3columns2rows in order E rightprofile,SE front-right,SW front-left,W leftprofile,NW rear-left,NE rear-right. Entire prop vertically oriented, long shaft fully visible, generous empty gutters. No hands/characters/letters/grid/background/cast shadows. Maintain correct rear details. Prop: crooked bone hex staff with a small hanging skull and dull green gemstone. Color theme matches Female elderly skeletal witch, curved black witch hood/cowl with bone antler ornaments, ivory skull face, ragged plum and charcoal robes with pale green ribbons, slender bony hands. Distinct angular witch silhouette.
effects: Transparent 2D hand-painted cel shaded fantasy GAME VFX SPRITESHEET. Exactly8columns4rows,32 individual animation frames. Each row one8frame left-to-right animation. Large transparent gutters between frames and rows. All cells same size, effect centered, frame0 small beginning then development then frame7 almost vanished. Absolutely no background haze rectangles, no whole-sheet mist, no text or grid, alpha outside individual effects ZERO. Arcane Vanguard boldclean shapes with subtle limited glow. ROW1: Small violet green bone curse projectile traveling right. ROW2: Ossify: ivory ribs and skull rune curl around a target in a skeletal transformation hex, then fade; no full humanoid. ROW3: Witch green hex spiral opens from small rune then fades. ROW4: Pale green spirit summoning swirl rises then disperses. No characters or weapons.
